description:
Reentrancy in PilotVault.rebalance(address,address,uint256,uint256,bytes,bytes32) (contracts/PilotVault.sol#433-467):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- amountOut = _swap(venue,sell,buy,amountIn,minAmountOut,route) (contracts/PilotVault.sol#459)
		- ISwapAdapter(venue).swap(sell.token,buy.token,amountIn,minAmountOut,address(this),route) (contracts/PilotVault.sol#681)
	Balance read before the call:
	- (sell,buy,totalBefore) = _legs(tokenIn,tokenOut) (contracts/PilotVault.sol#448)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- valueOut * BPS < valueIn * (BPS - limits.maxSlippageBps) (contracts/PilotVault.sol#462)
		- stale variable `valueOut`
markdown:
Reentrancy in [PilotVault.rebalance(address,address,uint256,uint256,bytes,bytes32)](contracts/PilotVault.sol#L433-L467):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- [amountOut = _swap(venue,sell,buy,amountIn,minAmountOut,route)](contracts/PilotVault.sol#L459)
		- [ISwapAdapter(venue).swap(sell.token,buy.token,amountIn,minAmountOut,address(this),route)](contracts/PilotVault.sol#L681)
	Balance read before the call:
	- [(sell,buy,totalBefore) = _legs(tokenIn,tokenOut)](contracts/PilotVault.sol#L448)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- [valueOut * BPS < valueIn * (BPS - limits.maxSlippageBps)](contracts/PilotVault.sol#L462)
		- stale variable `valueOut`
